banner.title: linkwarden
banner.tagline: Saves each bookmark as a readable archive, keeps its rows in a CloudNativePG database, and tags links through LiteLLM.

art.about: a bookmark manager that archives each saved page and tags it with a local language model
art.title: How linkwarden saves a link

explainer.title: A link in, a database row and an archive out

steps.title: Secret
steps.text: ExternalSecret linkwarden-secret builds the auth secret, the database URL and the LiteLLM key from 1Password items linkwarden and cloudnative-pg.
steps.scene: a key emerging from a vault

steps.title: Database
steps.text: The cnpg-database component creates role and database linkwarden on the shared postgres-18 cluster. init-db waits for them.
steps.scene: a database cylinder with a padlock

steps.title: Archive
steps.text: The app writes page archives to the claim linkwarden under /data/data. Monolith inlines each page into one file.
steps.scene: a web page folded into an archive box

steps.title: Tag
steps.text: Auto-tagging posts to LiteLLM with the chat-local alias on the B70. When that model is down, tagging fails and nothing else depends on it.
steps.scene: a bookmark card with glowing tag chips

steps.title: Keep
steps.text: kopiur backs up the data claim to Ceph and R2. The database is backed up by its CloudNativePG cluster.
